# Pulse of the Planets

> Audiovisual interactive work for real-time ambient music. Three orbiting bodies in a single
> Max/MSP patch drive note probability, pitch stability, filter brightness, level and stereo
> position; Max sends the result as MIDI to Ableton Live, which supplies the instruments and the
> mix. Author: Chaoran Yu (2025). Media is on Google Drive, not in the repository.

## Start here

- [docs/ai-assistant-guide.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/pulse-of-the-planets/main/docs/ai-assistant-guide.md): setup guide written for AI assistants — what to install, how to create the MIDI ports, how to verify (read this first if you are helping a human)
- [REPORT.pdf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/pulse-of-the-planets/main/REPORT.pdf): the written project report (20 pages)
- [docs/setup-guide.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/pulse-of-the-planets/main/docs/setup-guide.md): the operating manual
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/pulse-of-the-planets/main/README.md): project overview, demo links, requirements
- [README.zh-CN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chora666/pulse-of-the-planets/main/README.zh-CN.md): 简体中文说明

## Key facts

- Max 9.0.8 (x64) saved in the patch; developed on Windows
- Main patch: `patch/Pulse_of_the_Planets.maxpat` — one file, no abstractions, samples or third-party externals
- MIDI destinations are set by name: `loopMIDI Port 1` through `loopMIDI Port 7` (loopMIDI on Windows)
- The Ableton Live set is **not** in the repository; the report documents the intended MIDI mapping
- Three bodies: A (blue) quarter notes, B (purple) half notes, C (gold) whole notes
- Distance → trigger probability, pitch stability, filter brightness, level and pan
- Form: intro – verse – drop, with manual interaction (space bar / click) and a 15-press-in-4-seconds *Crazy Moment*
- Visuals: `jit.lcd` at 1920×1080 — halos, collision lines, Boom flash, 200-point star fields
- Media: demo video and audio recording on Google Drive, linked from the README
